Finance Minister Addresses Rupee Volatility and Tax Matters

Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman stated that the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) will continue to take action to prevent volatility in the rupee exchange rate. She also indicated that matters concerning Long-Term Capital Gains (LTCG) tax and Securities Transaction Tax (STT) would be keenly heard. Sitharaman explained that currency volatility is due to external factors and that the RBI will intervene to curb swings.
